title: K2U Platform Administrator Practice Exam 1 (32-question retake set)

cards.prompt: What modification can be made to standard fields?
cards.why: Standard fields are built into the platform. You can relabel them (Rename Tabs and Labels), edit help text, edit standard picklist values, set FLS, and place them on layouts.
cards.traps: Type, length, and deletion are only possible for custom fields.

cards.prompt: Support reps retype Account Owner, Owner Email, and Address on every Case. How do you automate this?
options: Formula fields to retrieve the Account information
answer: Formula fields to retrieve the Account information
cards.why: Cross-object formula fields on Case display parent Account data, always current, with no automation to maintain.
cards.traps: Validation rules only block; screen flows need clicks; assignment rules only set owners.
cards.strip: Display parent data → cross-object formula. Frozen copy → Flow. Summarize children → roll-up.

cards.prompt: Send a survey when a web-origin Case with Reason 'Product Inquiry' is closed. Which 3 are best practice?
options: Enable Surveys and create a Survey
Send from the record page with 'Send Survey'
answer: Enable Surveys and create a Survey
Send from the record page with 'Send Survey'
cards.why: Salesforce Surveys + a record-triggered flow automates it; the Send Survey action covers manual sends.
cards.traps: Content Builder is Marketing Cloud; batch Apex is code and delayed.

cards.prompt: Which field types can be the DEPENDENT field in a field dependency? (2)
cards.why: Dependent: custom picklists and custom multi-selects only.
cards.traps: Checkboxes and standard picklists can only control.

cards.prompt: How many users can be added to a group task in Lightning Experience?
cards.why: Lightning group tasks allow up to 200 users; each gets a separate copy. Older material says 100.

cards.prompt: Which report formats does Salesforce support? (3)
cards.why: Formats are TSMJ: Tabular, Summary, Matrix, Joined.
cards.traps: Custom and Standard are report types, not formats.

cards.prompt: Which field types can be the CONTROLLING field in a field dependency? (2)
cards.why: Controlling: picklists (standard or custom) and checkboxes.
cards.traps: Multi-selects can't control; formulas can't be on either side.

cards.prompt: In Lightning with Einstein Activity Capture, a user creates a task on a Contact. Where is it visible? (3)
cards.why: Activities roll up to the parent Account; Lightning uses the Activity Timeline. EAC-captured emails/events aren't stored as records, so they don't appear in standard reports.

cards.prompt: After restoring a custom field deleted 5 days ago, what should the admin do? (2)
options: Make the field required if necessary
Convert lookup to master-detail if required
answer: Make the field required if necessary
Convert lookup to master-detail if required
cards.why: Restored fields come back without Required, Unique, External ID; master-detail returns as lookup. Data, type, and name are restored. Restore window is 15 days.
cards.traps: 'If necessary' isn't hedging. 'Automatically' is the trap.

cards.prompt: Load 7 million records in one batch. How?
cards.why: 5 million is Data Loader's recommended threshold, not a hard cap; with the Bulk API it can handle more. This test bank expects Data Loader.
cards.traps: Import Wizard caps at 50,000.

cards.prompt: Managers create Chatter groups; only members and the director should see group details; the director manages all; no outsider can delete content. (2)
options: Give the director Modify All Data
Use private groups with the director added
cards.why: Unlisted groups are hidden from non-members entirely; private groups still show name and description.
cards.traps: Modify All Data violates least privilege.

cards.prompt: What validation checks field formats and maximum length on save?
cards.why: Order of execution: system validation first, then before-save flows, then custom validation rules, duplicate rules, save, assignment/auto-response/escalation, after-save flows, roll-ups, commit.

cards.prompt: Record-triggered flow: Rating → Hot sends email + ERP call; → Cold sends email. Without 'Is Changed', how should Decision outcomes run?
answer: Only if the record that triggered the flow is updated to meet the condition requirements
cards.why: Fires once when the record BECOMES Hot, not on every save while Hot. $Record__Prior holds old values; $CHANGED doesn't exist.

cards.prompt: Which tab gives a unified place to create reports and dashboards and organize them into collections?
cards.why: The Analytics tab uses collections. Reports and Dashboards are two separate tabs using folders.

cards.prompt: How do record types relate to business processes?
answer: A business process can be associated with multiple record types
cards.why: Each record type uses one business process; one process can serve many record types.

cards.prompt: Which capabilities does the Lightning email publisher in Case Feed have? (3)
answer: Preview the email and its merge fields
Insert tables and style them from the actions menu
cards.why: Confirmed by the retake.
cards.traps: Lookup with 'filter by field values' overpromises; static-resource images are a developer feature.

cards.prompt: High-value deal hits 80% probability: notify the Sales Director AND create a task. Which tool?
cards.why: Two actions. Big Deal Alert only emails.

cards.prompt: Which features are used to manage cases? (2)
cards.why: Web-to-Case allows 5,000/day; Web-to-Lead 500/day.
cards.traps: Phone-to-Case is made up; Web-to-Lead makes leads.

cards.prompt: What's true of the Automation Lightning app?
answer: View, search, filter, and create flows with a categorized creation experience
cards.why: Editing still happens in Flow Builder; errors arrive as fault emails.
cards.traps: 'All editions', 'automatically fixes', 'without Flow Builder' overpromise.

cards.prompt: A screen flow can't show all Expense records: OWD is Private and the user's role limits visibility. Fix?
answer: Run the flow in system context without sharing
cards.why: 'With sharing' still respects record sharing. Only 'without sharing' sees all records.
cards.traps: Apex is code; Grant Access Using Hierarchies only works downward.

cards.prompt: Agentforce can't find a case owned by another team, and the user can't find it in global search either. Most likely reason?
answer: Case OWD is Private and no sharing rule grants the agent access
cards.why: Agentforce works with the user's access. The human failing too points to sharing.
cards.traps: Trust Layer masks data, it doesn't hide records; View All Data is too broad.
cards.strip: Defining condition: the human can't find it either.

cards.prompt: A user can't log in. Possible reasons? (2)
answer: Logging in from an IP outside their profile's range
Logging in outside their profile's login hours
cards.why: Profile settings block.
cards.traps: Org-wide login hours don't exist; org trusted IPs only trigger verification.

cards.prompt: What can profiles be used for? (3)
answer: Control Apex class and Visualforce page access
cards.why: Profiles control what you can DO.
cards.traps: Role-based record visibility and manual sharing belong to the sharing model.

cards.prompt: Users should only see campaign members tied to leads or contacts they can access. What should the admin do?
answer: Change the Campaign Member OWD to 'Controlled by Lead or Contact'
cards.why: Restricting visibility = OWD. Sharing rules only open access.

cards.prompt: What's true about resetting passwords for locked-out users (no SSO)?
answer: The account is automatically unlocked after the password is reset
cards.why: A real absolute. Lockout periods: 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour, or Forever.
cards.traps: 'Any user can reset their own password' and the admin 5-per-day limit are false.

cards.prompt: Block all users on Sunday for maintenance. Best way?
answer: Login Hours on all profiles except System Administrator
cards.why: Time-based block = Login Hours. Freeze blocks per user; users are never deleted.

cards.prompt: Track which leads and contacts participate in this year's trade show.
answer: Associate the lead or contact with a campaign when they register
cards.why: Campaign Members with Member Status. Standard feature beats custom build.

cards.prompt: Show Opportunities with ARR > 100k on the Forecasts page and calculate gap-to-quota there. (2)
answer: Add a forecast filter within the forecast type
Create a custom calculated column in Forecasts Settings
cards.why: The question never mentions reports, so report answers are distractors.

cards.prompt: What's true about lead conversion? (3)
answer: A Contact is created if a match isn't found and selected
An Account is created if a match isn't found and selected
With Person Accounts enabled and no Company, a Person Account is created
cards.why: Opportunity is optional.
cards.traps: 'Always creates an opportunity'; custom lead fields map only to custom fields.

cards.prompt: A unique text field still has what look like duplicates. Why?
cards.why: Case sensitive lets 'ACME' and 'Acme' coexist.
cards.traps: 'Only', 'only', 'always'.

cards.prompt: Which final approval actions are available? (3)
cards.why: TEFO: Task, Email alert, Field update, Outbound message.

cards.prompt: One Agentforce action summarizes claims and rejects them 'without exception' when Policy Active is unchecked. Why is that bad practice?
answer: Strict, deterministic compliance decisions belong in Flow, not AI reasoning
cards.why: AI for language; Flow for rules.
cards.traps: Three invented limitations.
